Boot and halt routines, tick count wrapper, yield, and poll syscall helpers.

# Purpose
This file defines low-level runtime support functions for the `fd` environment. The [`fd_boot`](<#fd_boot>) and [`fd_halt`](<#fd_halt>) functions start and stop the private subsystems in the correct order, with [`fd_boot`](<#fd_boot>) setting up logging, shared memory, and tile state, and [`fd_halt`](<#fd_halt>) shutting them down in reverse order. The [`_fd_tickcount`](<#_fd_tickcount>) function forwards to `fd_tickcount`, and the hosted build section adds [`fd_yield`](<#fd_yield>) and [`fd_syscall_poll`](<#fd_syscall_poll>) wrappers for thread scheduling and polling system calls.
